title: Alert Using Same Key-Card Three or More Times in a One Hour Period
summary: Given a list of worker names and their key-card access times, identify and return a sorted list of unique worker names who used their key-card three or more times within any one-hour period.
statement: Given a list of worker names and their key-card access times, identify and return a sorted list of unique worker names who used their key-card three or more times within any one-hour period. The names should be sorted in ascending alphabetical order. The access times are in the 24-hour format "HH:MM".
constraints: Names and times have equal length from 1 through 100,000; times use HH:MM on one day.
Alert a name for at least three uses within an inclusive 60-minute span; return unique names alphabetically.
hints: After sorting one person’s times, any qualifying triple appears in three consecutive positions.
Group converted minutes by name and compare each time with the time two places later.
Alert when that inclusive difference is at most sixty, then sort the unique names.
If any window contains at least three events, its first three consecutive sorted events also fit in the same window.
editorial: If any window contains at least three events, its first three consecutive sorted events also fit in the same window.

tests.explanation: Daniel has three uses from 10:00 through 11:00 inclusive; Luis does not.
Neither person has three uses inside one hour.
